subject: Mobile Development
title: WebSockets: Real-Time Communication
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: WebSockets: Real-Time Communication.

hook.text: In a chat app, messages appear instantly. Regular API requests are too slow for that.

buildup.text: WebSockets open a persistent two-way connection between the app and server.

discovery.text: Once connected, either side can send messages instantly without waiting for a request.

twist.text: Keeping connections open on millions of phones requires massive server infrastructure.

climax.text: WebSockets power chat, gaming, stock tickers, and any app that needs real-time updates.

punchline.text: A persistent pipe delivers instant messages.

quiz.question: What makes WebSockets different from regular API calls?
options: They maintain a persistent two-way connection
